/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
p='ArkLib/ProofSystem/Binius/BinaryBasefold/Prelude.lean'
s=open(p).read(); a=s.index('theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius'); b=s.index('\\n/--\\nCompliance condition',a)
d=s[a:b]
d=d.replace('''    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
      refine Set.image_nonempty.mpr ?_

      exact Set.univ_nonempty''','''    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty''')
d=d.replace('''    rw [Set.mem_image] at h_sInf_mem
    rcases h_sInf_mem with ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩
    -- Extract the codeword and its membership proof.
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, by exact id (Eq.symm h_eq)⟩''','''    rcases Set.mem_image.mp h_sInf_mem with ⟨⟨g', hg⟩, -, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g', hg, rfl⟩''')
d=d.replace('''  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 "'^ steps := by
    -- exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size
    apply le_trans (a := d_H) (c := d_fw * 2 ''^ steps) (b := hammingDist f g'"')
    · -- ⊢ d_H ≤ ↑Δ₀(f, g')
      simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq, d_H];
      -- ⊢ Δ₀(f, C_i) ≤ ↑Δ₀(f, g')
      -- ⊢ sInf {d | ∃ v ∈ C_i, ↑(#{i | f i ≠ v i}) ≤ d} ≤ ↑(#{i | f i ≠ g' i})
      apply sInf_le
      use g'
    · exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size''','''  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 "'^ steps := by
    exact (show d_H ≤ hammingDist f g'"' from by
      simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq, d_H]
      apply sInf_le
      exact ⟨g', h_g'_mem, le_rfl⟩).trans h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size''')
open('/localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/nowhere','w') if False else None
open('candidate.lean','w').write(d+'\\n')
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
